plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to meet concentration limits and reduce income exposure.
Trim SPY to 15% to reduce broad index exposure.
Sell QQQ, SMH, METU, SNOW, SMCI to exit downtrending positions.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to zero for capital preservation.
Trim CRWD to 5% to take profit and reduce concentration.
This plan aims for capital preservation and a large cash buffer.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a potential ~1.5%/month return with a focus on capital preservation. It significantly reduces overall portfolio risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and trimming concentrated positions. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce broad index exposure.
Sell QQQ, SMH, METU, SNOW, SMCI to exit downtrending positions.
Trim SOXL to 3% and sell SPAL, MUU, PLTU to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim CRWD to 5% to take profit and reduce concentration.
This plan balances risk and growth with a moderate cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets a potential ~2.5%/month return, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while maintaining some exposure to quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a reasonable growth outlook.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% and SPY to 15% to meet concentration limits and free capital.
Sell QQQ, SMH, SNOW, SPAL, MUU, PLTU, SMCI to exit all downtrending positions.
Add to CRWD (10%), METU (6%), and MSFU (4%) to press working AI/Software positions.
Add to SOXL (6%) to increase leveraged semiconductor exposure.
This plan uses leverage and concentrates in high-scoring setups for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets a potential ~4%/month return by leaning into leverage and concentration. It significantly increases both upside potential and drawdown risk. Leveraged ETFs decay daily and can lose a lot fast; strict stop discipline is crucial. Expect high volatility and potentially large drawdowns.

plan: Add to QQQI (30%) to increase income exposure.
Trim SPY to 10% to reduce broad index exposure.
Sell QQQ, SMH, METU, SNOW, SMCI to exit growth-oriented positions.
Trim CRWD to 5% to reduce high-beta tech exposure.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to near zero.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets a potential ~1%/month return by rotating into income-generating ETFs. It aims for low drawdown and reliable monthly distributions, but these are variable and NAV can still fall. This is not a savings account; expect cash-like income with some market exposure.
